title: aws-node must carry ENABLE_IPv4 and ENABLE_IPv6 (v1.10+) — an image-only bump crash-loops ipamd

detection.reason: the rule asks whether two env vars are ABSENT from the aws-node container; the detection vocabulary can only test presence, so the hint names the DaemonSet and the command checks both names

quote: cni v1.10.x introduced 2 new env variables - ENABLE_IPv4 and ENABLE_IPv6. The above error can be caused if you miss adding these env variables to your cni daemonset.
remediation: Upgrade by applying the full release manifest (or the EKS add-on / chart), not by editing the image tag on the existing DaemonSet: v1.10+ expects ENABLE_IPv4 (default true) and ENABLE_IPv6 (default false) on the aws-node container, and without them ipamd panics with a nil-pointer in StartNodeIPPoolManager and every new pod waits for an IP.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get ds aws-node -o json | jq -r '[.spec.template.spec.containers[] | select(.name == "aws-node") | .env[]?.name] as $e | if (($e | index("ENABLE_IPv4")) and ($e | index("ENABLE_IPv6"))) then "ok: both set" else "MISSING: ENABLE_IPv4 and/or ENABLE_IPv6" end'  # MISSING = ipamd crash-loops on v1.10+; apply the release manifest instead of only bumping the image
coversNotes: ENABLE_IPv4 (v1.10.0+) Type: Boolean as a String Default: true VPC CNI can operate in
ENABLE_IPv6 (v1.10.0+) Type: Boolean as a String Default: false VPC CNI can operate in
